## Summary

Describe the user problem or defect and the resulting behavior.

## Scope and boundaries

Identify the affected workflow, authorization boundary, architecture area, or
linked issue. Note any migration or compatibility considerations.

## Verification

List the commands and manual checks you ran, with their results. Identify any
relevant check that was not run and explain why.

## Evidence

Add screenshots for user-interface changes. Label local, mocked, staging,
provider, and production observations accurately.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read and followed `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] This change is within the supported product scope or has maintainer
      agreement in a linked issue.
- [ ] I added or updated behavioral coverage where the observable behavior
      changed.
- [ ] I updated contracts and documentation where applicable.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, private records, provider payloads, browser
      profiles, recordings, generated output, or private evidence.
- [ ] I included screenshots for user-interface changes, or the change has no
      user-interface impact.
- [ ] I listed every relevant check that I could not run and why.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this work and agree that it may be distributed
      under the Elastic License 2.0.
